phrase.zh: 细胞之外，变化依然在发生。

visual.zh: 压榨器、研钵、封口玻璃瓶与想象性的酵母细胞形态组成独立拼贴，呼应从细胞中提取物质并研究发酵的工作。器具不复原真实实验，也不表示可照做的实验步骤。
visual.en: A press, mortar, closed glass bottle and imagined yeast-cell shapes form an original collage about extracting material from cells and studying fermentation. The apparatus neither reconstructs a historical experiment nor provides an experimental procedure.

background.zh:
爱德华·布赫纳因生物化学研究，尤其是无细胞发酵研究，获得1907年诺贝尔化学奖。1897年，他发现不含活酵母细胞的提取液仍能使糖发酵。这表明发酵不一定需要完整的活细胞参与，关键作用来自酶——细胞产生、促使化学反应发生的物质。配图以提取器具和封口容器表现这一研究问题。
1907年化学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他的生物化学研究，尤其是无细胞发酵研究。
background.en:
Eduard Buchner received the 1907 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for biochemical research, particularly cell-free fermentation. In 1897, he showed that a yeast extract without living yeast cells could still ferment sugar. Fermentation therefore did not require intact living cells; enzymes, substances produced by cells that promote chemical reactions, played the key role. The artwork interprets that question through extraction tools and closed vessels.
1907 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his biochemical researches and his discovery of cell-free fermentation
